meta.title: A bid's total is the same in every place on a charges template
gaps: the plan has the vendor send GET /v1/trade/{{tradeId}}/event_indicators, but the vendor's session may not call GET /v1/trade/:id/event_indicators (trade#event_indicators is not on that app's list in config/app_auth_config.yml)
cannot read the gross_total, landed_amount, or quote details directly (no operation defined)
cannot compare totals across stage, quote, and bid record because appropriate read endpoints are missing
warnings: verify 2: read_indicators's reply shape has not been sampled; "auction_identifiers_data.{{vendorUuid}}.inline.{{lineItemUuid}}.rank.best_bidder" is unverified

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event with two QA vendors invited, each with a submitted bid; bidding still open.
steps: As the invited QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that “bid count” is at least 1.
As the invited QA vendor, read the round's comparison (ranks, best bidder) and check that “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is present.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “bid count” is at least 1; “auction identifiers data › QA vendor 1 › inline › the line › rank › best bidder” is present.
